legacy_allowance.note: Legacy (manifest-less) serving allowance is DISABLED and expired. ED_ARTIFACT_INTEGRITY_STRICT=0 is honored ONLY while this allowance is enabled AND unexpired; afterwards the environment cannot reopen legacy serving (no indefinite grandfathering, no reopen after strict activation).

strict_activation_condition: verify_fleet(models_dir).ok == true (every active bundle manifest-verified or quarantined out of serving); enforced at runtime by artifact_integrity_strict_absence() reading THIS committed policy — the environment flag is never the only mechanism

evidence_rules.REPROMOTED_FROM_GOVERNED_CANDIDATE: complete 7-file candidate bundle + scheduler_run_manifest.json in a governed training-output dir; promotion through promote_horizon_bundle_from_candidate (atomic replace + manifest stamp + lineage)
evidence_rules.RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE: every artifact byte-identical to a governed candidate file (sha256) or to the git-HEAD tracked blob (git object id; CRLF-normalized equality admitted only for tracked *_meta.json text files whose divergence is checkout smudge)
evidence_rules.FORBIDDEN: hashing whatever bytes exist in an active directory and declaring them trusted without independent source evidence

quarantine.rule: bytes replaced or removed by migration are copied there FIRST (full bundle, timestamped); unproven bundles with no governed candidate are quarantined out of serving, never blessed
quarantine.rollback: restore the timestamped bundle copy into the active dir and delete the stamped manifest (returns the bundle to explicit legacy state, which strict mode then refuses — rollback restores bytes, not trust)

runtime_behavior_when_bundle_unavailable: fail closed per ml_predict strict resolution (STRICT_ACTIVE_FAIL_CLOSED; no cross-ticker or cross-horizon substitution; guest tickers route only through the governed anchor path)
operator_visibility: build_model_serving_provenance.artifact_integrity per serve (VERIFIED_AGAINST_BUNDLE_MANIFEST / LEGACY_UNVERIFIED_NO_BUNDLE_MANIFEST / VERIFICATION_FAILED_CLOSED / NOT_LOADED) on the serve payload surface (MarketState.model_serving_provenance_v1 -> _ms_to_dict); NOT persisted per snapshot row (db.py insert_snapshot has no provenance column - operator DB-schema decision, see OPEN_ITEMS REAL-GATE)
python tools/ml_item4_fleet_migration.py --verify-fleet (exit 1 on any unverified active bundle)
governance/artifacts/ML_ITEM4_MIGRATION_STATE.json (report only; filesystem recompute is the trusted source)
